# xdu-project.org — landing page

`index.html` is the page. The other two files are the alternate skins that were
considered alongside it; they are kept for reference, not for publication.

**The copy is identical in all three.** The alternates are generated by lifting
the content out of a single shared template (`build-motif.py` /
`build-geocities.py` in the authoring session), so prose edits propagate rather
than drifting between skins. Only the shell markup and the CSS differ.

| File | Theme | Body type | Feel |
|---|---|---|---|
| **`index.html`** | **Motif / CDE workstation** | Helvetica | **Chosen.** The whole page is one mwm window: title bar, toolbar, `XmFrame` sections, `XmList` tables, status line. Suits the TUI story. |
| `index-netscape.html` | NCSA / Netscape grey, c. 1996 | Times | A university systems-software page. Sober; carries the roadmap prose well. |
| `index-geocities.html` | GeoCities maximalist, c. 1997 | Verdana / Comic Sans | Starfield, rainbow rules, marquee, hit counter, 88×31 badges, webring, caution tape on the roadmap. |

## Nothing in the chrome is a decoy

The window furniture is period-accurate but it never pretends to an
interaction it cannot honour:

- The strip under the title bar is a **toolbar of real links**, not a menu bar.
  Every button scrolls to a section; `Source` sits hard right, where Motif parks
  the Help cascade. An earlier draft had a `File / Edit / View / …` menu bar —
  it was cut, because a menu that opens nothing is a broken promise.
- The **status line** carries facts (version, command count, licence, date),
  not a fake `Ready.`
- The title-bar and xterm window boxes are the one exception, and they read as
  what they are: decoration on a picture of a window, promising nothing.

## Common properties

- One file. **No scripts, no external requests, no cookies, no images** — every
  graphic (bevels, X11 root stipple, window glyphs) is drawn in CSS.
- Responsive to ~390px; tables, shell blocks and terminal mockups scroll inside
  their own containers rather than widening the page. Verified by headless
  render at 1150 / 760 / 390px, light and dark.
- `prefers-color-scheme: dark` variant. Print stylesheet drops the chrome.
- Semantic HTML, skip link, `scroll-margin` on anchors, accessible tables, and
  a check that every toolbar link resolves to a real anchor.

## The terminal mockups

Hand-built from the actual source, not invented:

- Crawl output matches `src/bin/xdu.rs` — the 12-column right-aligned
  `Finished` / `Completed` lines, `format_count` / `format_bytes` /
  `format_speed` output (note `format_bytes` tops out at TiB, and `1.0B` is
  literally what `format_count` prints for a billion), the `[Tn]` driver label,
  and indicatif 0.17's default spinner tick set.
- `xdu-view` list and tree views match the ratatui renderers, including the
  filter-annotated title bar and the status line truncated at 80 columns.
- The shell transcript matches real output: `--top` prints bare partition
  names, `--count` and the `xdu-rm` summaries print raw integers with no
  thousands separators, and `-f size` emits `bytes\tpath`.

Every column in every mockup is generated with a width assertion, so the box
drawing cannot drift.

## Roadmap treatment

Every `ROADMAP.md` entry is written in the present tense as though shipped,
annotated with a horizon-mapped imagined version: near-term → v0.6.x,
mid-term → v0.7–v0.9, long-term → v1.0–v1.3. The 14 user-facing entries get
full treatment; the internal hardening, CI and man-page items go in a compact
table. An "already shipped" note covers the 0.5 series so the annotation legend
is credible.

## Hosting

GitHub Pages serves from the repo root or `/docs`. `www/` deliberately avoids
colliding with `doc/` (the scdoc man-page sources), so pick one of:

- point Pages at a `gh-pages` branch built from this directory, or
- copy `index.html` to `/docs/index.html`, or
- move `index.html` to the repo root.

All links are absolute to `github.com/xdu-project/xdu`; the canonical URL and
Open Graph tags point at `https://xdu-project.org/`.
